description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Other' within the OpenCart administration extension system. It manages listing, installation, and uninstallation of 'other' type extensions, handling permission checks, dynamic loading of extension components, and rendering views.

classes.name: Other
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'other' type extensions in the OpenCart admin interface, including listing available extensions, installing new ones, and uninstalling existing ones.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entrypoint method that outputs the list view of extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares data for displaying the list of 'other' extensions, including checking installed extensions and their status, loading language strings, and rendering the view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of an extension, including permission checks, registering controllers/models, and calling optional install scripts.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process for an extension, including permissions, removing from extension list, and calling uninstall scripts.
